mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, with no exception for development builds. This is reinforced by the recorded rule to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
